explication: Spec Kit is a CLI toolkit for structured, agent-assisted software work. The primary workflow is: a developer initializes a project, selects an AI-agent integration, installs the generated process assets, then invokes workflows that execute typed steps and persist resumable state. The CLI also supports installing extensions, presets, and bundles, inspecting artifacts, and wiring runtime events. The graph emphasizes documented capabilities and sampled orchestration; unsampled implementation details and exact network call chains are intentionally omitted.
